top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the staff was aware of a child receiving medical attention after sustaining an injury while in care, but did not report to Child Care Licensing within two days of becoming notified.

top_violation_types.title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A Caregiver admitted to smoking a vape cigarette in the breakroom of the facility   while children were present.

top_violation_types.title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - First Aid and CPR (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was discovered a caregiver did not provide first aid to an injured child.

top_violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Multiple Opportunities to Explore Outside Crib (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Through the information obtained during the inspection, it was found that infants were not being taken outside.    The Director is correcting this by ordering a baby buggy for ouotdoors and in the process of making a place for babies to have tummy time outside.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.
